title: Israeli Strikes Kill Two, Hit Hospital Supply Warehouse in Gaza
detail: Israeli strikes across Gaza killed two Palestinians and struck a hospital supply warehouse, threatening medical supply chains in the territory. The attack on the warehouse raised alarms over humanitarian access and the ability to sustain medical operations in Gaza.

media.caption: Israeli strikes across Gaza kill two Palestinians and hit a hospital supply warehouse

title: Israeli Strikes Kill Four More Across Gaza City, Khan Younis, Al-Musaddar as Hospital Warehouse Struck Again
detail: In addition to the hospital-adjacent strikes reported Saturday, August 29, 2026, Israeli strikes killed at least four Palestinians elsewhere in Gaza: two in a drone strike on an electric bike in Gaza City (the military said it targeted a 'military operative'), one in a separate strike in Khan Younis, and one by gunfire in al-Musaddar village. An Israeli drone separately struck a tent functioning as a medical-supply warehouse inside the Al-Aqsa Martyrs Hospital compound in Deir al-Balah — the second strike on the same facility within a month — wounding three; MSF said 'at time when Israeli forces are routinely targeting hospitals, it is of utmost importance that all parties respect and preserve the neutrality and protection of medical facilities.' An explosive device was also dropped near Kamal Adwan Hospital in northern Gaza. Gaza's Health Ministry said hospitals received 10 bodies over the preceding 48 hours, and the toll since the October 2025 ceasefire has risen to 1,313 killed and 4,361 injured; an estimated 4,000-5,000 Palestinians remain missing under rubble.

media.caption: Palestinian mourners at a funeral held at Al-Aqsa Martyrs Hospital, Deir al-Balah, Aug 29, 2026

title: IDF Strikes Kill Four Hamas Nukhba Force Members in Jabalia and Khan Younis
detail: An Israeli strike on Jabalia refugee camp in northern Gaza on Saturday, August 29, 2026 killed Abd al-Fatah Abu al-Eish, whom the IDF identified as a Hamas Nukhba Force commander who took part in the October 7, 2023 attack, along with a second operative, Raed Adel Mohammed Alyan. A separate strike in Khan Younis, southern Gaza, killed two more Nukhba Force members, Yasser Abu al-Khair and Mohammed al-Din. The IDF said all four had been 'advancing attacks on troops and civilians' and 'violating the ceasefire agreement.'
